hypothesis: Combining EMA momentum with RSI overbought/oversold signals and ATR-based risk management filters out low-quality entries and provides dynamic stop-loss/take-profit levels that adapt to volatility, improving risk-adjusted returns in BTCUSDC 1h timeframe

Combining EMA trend filter with RSI momentum and ATR volatility scaling creates a robust entry/exit system that avoids false signals during ranging periods while maintaining sensitivity to trending moves. The EMA ensures we only trade in the direction of the dominant trend, RSI confirms momentum strength, and ATR provides dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels that adapt to market volatility.
